description.en: Like CreateSpeech, but opens the window with two more settings: DrawScr = SCREEN_A and OnTeamLv = true (CMND_MESSAGE_OPEN(_id, false, false, true, _chara, _bRight, SCREEN_A, true)); it then waits with suspend() until CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE() is false, that is until the player has read and closed the message. The events use it for the question asked before a match starts.
Speaking character (parameter ID or hash), shown as the speaker.
true to show the speaker on the right side.

examples.case: Asking before a match (real usage, from ev42022000.nut)
